subtitle: Crossing of September 1, 2026: Polymarket price in the confirmed reading of Sep 1, 8:34 PM BRT (11:34 PM UTC), presidential book at USD 141.39M, against Real Time Big Data of Sep 1 (BR-03490/2026, field Aug 27 to 31, n=2,000, margin of 2pp), the only national poll released this Tuesday. It is the first in the panel whose field reaches Aug 31, and therefore the first to cover the full week after the campaign broadcast slot began on Aug 28. The pollster published TWO first-round scenarios, one with Pablo Marçal and one without, and they give different numbers for the second and third places.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 55.50% (vol USD 9.56M accumulated), confirmed reading of Sep 1, 8:34 PM BRT (11:34 PM UTC). Unchanged on the day, and his price has not left 55.50% for the fourth day running. POLL: Real Time Big Data of Sep 1 (BR-03490/2026, field Aug 27 to 31, n=2,000, margin of 2pp) gives him 38% in both first-round scenarios and 44% in a runoff against the runner-up, who also has 44%. Against Ronaldo Caiado he comes out behind, 45% to 43%.
fortes: He remains in front in the first round in the only national poll of Tuesday, with 38% in both scenarios, and the distance to the runner-up is 9 points in the scenario with Marçal and 8 in the one without.
In the price, it is the fourth day running at 55.50%, and the distance to the runner-up widened to 16.55pp without him having to move.
The ruling that had suspended his opponent’s advertising in the registration case was reversed, but his own advertising was also targeted: the panel records both, and neither moved the price.
His rejection is 50%, tied with the runner-up’s, and it is not the highest in the table.
The first-round runner-up contract keeps him at 9.20%, that is, the market still treats his reaching the runoff as the dominant scenario and not as a contest.
fracos: HE COMES OUT BEHIND IN A RUNOFF SCENARIO FOR THE FIRST TIME AGAINST A NAME THAT IS NOT THE RUNNER-UP: he loses to Ronaldo Caiado, 45% to 43%. Across the 41 runoff simulations in the panel’s base he has trailed in four, and all four were against the same opponent.
The runoff against the runner-up left the favourable signal of Aug 31 and went back to a tie, at 44% to 44%.
His advertising that used the Rap do Silva was suspended for not presenting his running mate, according to Estadão, CartaCapital and Metrópoles.
The 38% of this poll sits below the 43.4% of AtlasIntel and above the 39% of BTG/Nexus, both from Aug 31, and the spread between pollsters on the same name remains wide.
Government disapproval remains above approval in the two most recent readings, both from Aug 31, and there was no new approval reading this Tuesday.
candidates.analise: Tuesday brought a single national poll, and it is the first in the panel to cover the full week after the campaign broadcast slot began. In the first round his picture does not change: 38% in both scenarios, in front. What changes is the runoff. Against the runner-up he went back to a tie, at 44% to 44%, after the favourable signal of Aug 31. And against Ronaldo Caiado he comes out behind, 45% to 43%, which in the panel’s base had only happened against one opponent until today. None of that showed in the price: he holds at 55.50% for the fourth day, and the distance to the runner-up widened by 0.10pp through a move on the other side. It is the difference between the two quantities becoming visible on the same day, one measuring declared intention in a hypothetical scenario and the other measuring the chance of winning in the real one.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 38.95% (vol USD 9.43M accumulated), confirmed reading of Sep 1, 8:34 PM BRT (11:34 PM UTC). Down 0.10pp on the day. In the first-round runner-up contract he rose 0.50pp, to 86.00%. POLL: Real Time Big Data of Sep 1 (BR-03490/2026, field Aug 27 to 31, n=2,000, margin of 2pp) gives him 29% in the scenario with Pablo Marçal and 30% in the one without, and in a runoff he ties the leader at 44% to 44%.
fortes: He ties the leader in the runoff, at 44% to 44%, after coming out behind by 1 point at BTG/Nexus and by 4.5 at AtlasIntel, both on Aug 31.
The first-round runner-up contract rose to 86.00%, up 0.50pp, and it is the most consolidated position on the panel after the leader’s first place.
His rejection is 50%, tied with the leader’s, and it is no longer the single highest as in the two readings of Aug 31.
The day’s price drop is 0.10pp, that is, he held nearly all of the position after the 2.05pp correction of the previous day.
fracos: He is the name whose number changes with the scenario: 29% with Marçal on the list and 30% without. The difference is small, but it is he and the third-placed name who absorb the other name’s exit.
The 29% or 30% of this poll sit below the 33.7% of AtlasIntel and the 33% of BTG/Nexus, both from Aug 31, that is, the third reading in a row puts him at a lower level.
In the price, he has been falling since the peak of 41.20% on Aug 30, and stands 2.25pp below it.
A request to remove him from his Senate seat was taken to the Supreme Court, according to Folha de S.Paulo.
The distance to the leader in the price widened again, to 16.55pp, and the widening came from his side.
candidates.analise: Tuesday’s poll puts him at a lower level than the two of Aug 31 in the first round, between 29% and 30% depending on the scenario, and at the same time in a better position in the runoff, where he ties at 44% to 44%. The two things do not contradict each other: one measures the field split among seven names and the other measures it split between two. In the price he barely moved, down 0.10pp, after giving up 2.05pp the day before. And the contract that measures his reaching the runoff rose to 86.00%, which indicates the market treated the day as confirmation of his position, not as a threat to it. The public demand he made for a Supreme Court justice to leave shows in neither of the two measurements.

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: PRICE: 2.55% (vol USD 12.30M accumulated), confirmed reading of Sep 1, 8:34 PM BRT (11:34 PM UTC). Up 0.70pp on the day, the largest percentage move among the names in the presidential contract this round. POLL: Real Time Big Data of Sep 1 (BR-03490/2026, field Aug 27 to 31, n=2,000, margin of 2pp) gives him 6% in the scenario with Pablo Marçal, third name outside the top two. In a runoff he loses to the leader, 44% to 37%.
fortes: THE RULING THAT WAS BLOCKING HIS CAMPAIGN WAS REVERSED. Dias Toffoli released the ticket’s campaign advertising on social media, according to Folha de S.Paulo, reversing the previous day’s suspension that also hit funding transfers and the right to debate.
His price rose 0.70pp on the same day, from 1.85% to 2.55%, the largest move among the names in the presidential contract this round.
The 6% from Real Time in the scenario with Marçal sit above the 3% BTG/Nexus gave him on Aug 31 and below the 7.6% of AtlasIntel from the same day.
His accumulated volume remains the largest in the presidential book among the names below the top two, at USD 12.30M.
The earlier ruling against him drew criticism inside the electoral court itself, and justices argued for taking the matter to the full bench, according to G1.
fracos: He lost the lead in the first-round third-place contract to Augusto Cury: he is at 30.00% against 46.65% for the other.
In the runoff against the leader he loses 44% to 37%, a distance of 7 points, the second widest among the alternative scenarios tested by the pollster.
His rejection is 40% in this poll, above that of Caiado, Zema and Cury.
Releasing the campaign is the reversal of a ruling, not a decision on the merits: the judgment on the ticket’s registration remains unresolved.

He took part in a protest calling for a Supreme Court justice’s impeachment on the same day, according to Folha de S.Paulo, which keeps his name tied to the institutional dispute rather than to the campaign agenda.
candidates.analise: It is the cleanest crossing of the round. The day before he had his best poll and his worst court ruling on the same day, and the price fell 0.40pp. This Tuesday the ruling was reversed, the campaign was released, and the price rose 0.70pp, more than it had fallen. The move is the size of what the ruling had taken away, and in the opposite direction. At the same time, he lost the lead in the third-place contract to Augusto Cury, which shows the recovery was in his position in the winner contract and not in his relative position in the race for third. In declared polling he stands at 6%, between the 3% of BTG/Nexus and the 7.6% of AtlasIntel, both from Aug 31.

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: PRICE: Caiado 0.25% (vol USD 7.03M), Haddad and Zema below 0.20%. All three remain below the 0.5% floor of the double reading, and this round publishes no new price for any of them. POLL: Real Time Big Data of Sep 1 (BR-03490/2026, field Aug 27 to 31, n=2,000, margin of 2pp) gives Ronaldo Caiado 4% in the first round and Romeu Zema 2%. ⚠️ IN THE RUNOFF, CAIADO COMES OUT AHEAD OF THE LEADER, 45% TO 43%.
candidates.subtitle: Back of the pack in the confirmed reading of Sep 1, 8:34 PM BRT (11:34 PM UTC), and this round it stopped being only the back of the pack. Ronaldo Caiado has 4% in the first round and even so comes out ahead of the leader in a runoff scenario, 45% to 43%. Across the 41 runoff simulations in the panel’s base, the leader has trailed in four, and all four were against the runner-up. It is the first time in the base that a name other than him shows in front.

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), presidential Poly 0.25% (vol USD 7.03M accumulated), below the 0.5% floor of the double reading. This round publishes no new price for him. In the first-round third-place contract he is at 13.00%, third name. ⚠️ IN DECLARED POLLING HE BEATS THE LEADER IN A RUNOFF, 45% TO 43%.
caiado.fortes: He is the only name on the panel who comes out ahead of the leader in a runoff scenario this round, 45% to 43%, and that had not happened in the base with any name outside the runner-up. His rejection is 39%, eleven points below the leader’s and the runner-up’s. In the first-round third-place contract he holds 13.00%.
caiado.fracos: In the first round he has 4%, behind Augusto Cury and Renan Santos, that is, the scenario in which he wins is not the scenario he reaches. In the winner contract he remains at 0.25%, below the 0.5% floor at which the double reading certifies a move. The distance between the 4% declared polling gives him and the 0.25% of implied probability is large, and the two quantities do not subtract: one measures first-round voting intention and the other measures the chance of winning the election.

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), presidential Poly below 0.20% (vol USD 7.41M accumulated), below the 0.5% floor of the double reading. This round publishes no new price for him.
haddad.fortes: He said there are no friends and enemies in the bank case and defended the investigation into the businessman’s dealings with the Supreme Court, according to Folha de S.Paulo, which keeps him in the case’s coverage through the institutional route rather than the campaign one.
haddad.fracos: He does not appear in the first-round or runoff scenarios of this Tuesday’s poll. In the price he remains below the watch floor.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), presidential Poly below 0.20% (vol USD 6.37M accumulated), below the 0.5% floor of the double reading. This round publishes no new price for him. In the first-round third-place contract he is at 0.80%.
zema.fortes: He has 2% in the first round and the lowest rejection in the table after Augusto Cury, at 36%. In a runoff he loses to the leader 43% to 40%, a distance of 3 points, the narrowest among the scenarios in which the leader wins.
zema.fracos: The 2% of the first round leave him fifth among the names tested. He publicly demanded a Supreme Court justice’s departure, according to Folha de S.Paulo, and appears in the coverage for that subject and not for a campaign agenda of his own.

candidates.analise: The back of the pack produced the strongest number of the round, and it is a poll number and not a price one. Ronaldo Caiado has 4% in the first round and beats the leader in a simulated runoff, 45% to 43%. It is the first time in the panel’s base that someone outside the runner-up shows in front in a scenario like that, and the correct reading is not that he is competitive: it is that the electorate that rejects the leader has less resistance to him than to the runner-up, whose rejection is 50% against his 39%. The price does not react to that, and it should not: the contract measures the chance of winning the election, and to win one must first reach the runoff, which is exactly where the 4% leave him out. All three remain below the 0.5% floor of the double reading.
fortes: Ronaldo Caiado comes out ahead of the leader in a runoff scenario, 45% to 43%, which had not occurred in the panel’s base with any name outside the runner-up.
The rejection of all three is lower than that of the top two: Caiado 39%, Zema 36%, against 50% for the leader and 50% for the runner-up.
Zema loses the runoff by 3 points, the narrowest distance among the scenarios in which the leader wins.
All three still carry meaningful accumulated volume in the presidential book, between USD 6.37M and USD 7.41M.
fracos: None of the three passes 4% in the first round, and the scenario in which Caiado wins is one he does not reach by the first-round table itself.
All three remain below the 0.5% floor in the winner contract, and that is why this round publishes no new price for any of them.
Haddad is not tested in any scenario of this poll.
Two of the three appear in Tuesday’s coverage because of the Supreme Court crisis, not because of a campaign agenda of their own.

quadroComparativo.p: No poll. Market on the impeachment of a Supreme Court justice before 2027.
quadroComparativo.m: 10.85% (vol USD 86 thousand), confirmed reading of Sep 1, 8:34 PM BRT (11:34 PM UTC). Up 7.25pp against the 3.60% of Aug 31, the panel’s largest move this round. ⚠️ IT IS THE SMALLEST BOOK ON THE PANEL: accumulated volume went from USD 84 thousand to USD 86 thousand, that is, some USD 2 thousand of new business accompanies the swing. Within the day the price passed through 3.50%, 13.80%, 10.70%, 19.10% and 14.30% before settling at 10.85% in the reading.
quadroComparativo.t: the panel’s largest move, in the panel’s smallest book, on the day the report’s secrecy was lifted
quadroComparativo.s: The Federal Police report on the relationship between Daniel Vorcaro and Justice Alexandre de Moraes was delivered on August 27 and had its secrecy lifted on September 1 by Justice André Mendonça, according to Poder360. The document indicates that Moraes edited a contract worth BRL 131 million between his wife’s law firm and the businessman, in custody since November 17, 2025. The prosecutor general asked for the report to be annulled, according to O Globo. Mendonça asked for a full-bench session to discuss the messages. Four presidential candidates demanded the justice’s departure. The Senate president signalled he will not schedule impeachment, according to Folha de S.Paulo. The joint committee on the pension agency requested an investigation into the contract, according to Times Brasil.

cruzamento: September 1 is the round in which the panel’s two measurements point to different places, and that is what sets it apart from the day before. In declared polling, Real Time Big Data of Sep 1 (BR-03490/2026, field Aug 27 to 31, n=2,000) brings three new things: the runoff between the top two went back to a tie, at 44% to 44%; Augusto Cury reached double digits from a second pollster in a row, with 10% in the scenario with Pablo Marçal and 11% in the one without; and Ronaldo Caiado, with 4% in the first round, comes out ahead of the leader in a simulated runoff, 45% to 43%. That last one is unprecedented in the panel’s base for a name other than the runner-up. In the price, almost none of that showed. The leader stayed at 55.50% for the fourth day running and the runner-up gave up 0.10pp, to 38.95%. What moved were the names below: Renan Santos rose 0.70pp, to 2.55%, on the same day the ruling that was blocking his campaign was reversed, and Augusto Cury rose 0.50pp, to 2.35%, besides taking the lead in the third-place contract with 46.65%. The panel’s largest move, however, is not a candidate’s: the contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving through impeachment before 2027 went from 3.60% to 10.85%, up 7.25pp, on the day the secrecy was lifted on the Federal Police report about the relationship between a justice of the court and a businessman in custody since November 2025. The size of that book has to be stated, because it changes the reading: it holds USD 86 thousand accumulated, the smallest on the panel, and some USD 2 thousand of new business accompanies the swing. The panel does not claim that one measurement corrects the other. It records that the poll measured the electorate’s resistance to alternative names in a hypothetical scenario, that the price measured the chance of winning in the real one, and that on a day of institutional crisis the two moved on very different scales.
